name: Clamshell

instructions.description: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent and heels stacked together.
Place a light resistance band above the knees if available and keep the pelvis stacked.
Lift the top knee away from the lower knee while keeping the feet together.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a small controlled range that keeps the pelvis still.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Straighten the top leg to challenge the hip in a longer lever.

commentsNotes: Do not roll the trunk backward to lift higher.
Focus on the side of the hip doing the work.
